evals.prompt: Use psy-finish. The verified direct commit is already the requested final result; no integration or release was requested.
evals.expected_output: Confirm completion without manufacturing a merge, next prompt or cleanup.

evals.prompt: Use psy-finish to merge this owned branch locally. The documented helper supports --local-only.
evals.expected_output: Use the local-only repository workflow, verify exact integration state, and do not push.

evals.prompt: Use psy-finish to prepare this branch for review; do not merge or push.
evals.expected_output: Verify scoped readiness and report the candidate while preserving explicit integration restrictions.

evals.prompt: Use psy-finish. One required regression test fails and there are unrelated dirty files.
evals.expected_output: Address or report the failing check; never stage unrelated changes or claim the branch ready.

evals.prompt: Use psy-finish to merge the branch. This repository has no custom workflow; the destination base and merge strategy are verified.
evals.expected_output: Use ordinary Git within the authorized scope after checkout/ownership checks; do not require custom tooling or delete resources without authority.

evals.prompt: Use psy-finish. The required closeout helper refused because the worktree belongs to another session.
evals.expected_output: Report the ownership blocker and use the supported capability route; never retry with raw Git or filesystem removal.
